en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large, fortress‑like historic complex with high plain walls and steep gabled tiled roofs. The building has many small rectangular windows, several chimneys, a corner tower with a steep roof, and a domed turret with a cross. It is surrounded by high perimeter walls and leafy trees in the foreground; no people or vehicles are visible. The style suggests a Central European castle or palace adapted to later uses. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
